title: Major disaster declared: Flooding, Illinois (DR-941)
summary: FEMA major disaster declaration for Illinois (flood), declared 1992-04-15.

title: MIDLAND BRAKE, INC.: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS (23,000 affected)
summary: THERE IS AN INTERFERENCE FIT BETWEEN THE VALVE COVER BORE AND THE VALVE PISTON. THIS INTERFERENCE FIT SITUATION HAS BEEN AGGRAVATED BY LIQUID CONTAMINATION WITHIN THE AIR SYSTEM WHICH HAS CAUSED THE PISTON TO SWELL AND STICK (SEIZE) IN THE CYLINDER BORE.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:VALVE:HAND CONTROL (146 affected)
summary: THE TRAILER HAND BRAKE CONTROL SYSTEM MAY HAVE THE WRONG VALVE INSTALLED WHICH LIMITS THE AIR PRESSURE TO THE TRAILER BRAKES BELOW THE REQUIRED PRESSURE.

title: General Motors, LLC: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:POWER WINDOW DOOR AND SIDE (37,030 affected)
summary: MOISTURE CAN ENTER THE EXPRESS-DOWN ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE AND CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT THAT CAUSES WINDOW OPERATION WITHOUT OPERATOR CONTROL, AND LEAVES THE WINDOW IN THE DOWN POSITION.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (9,500 affected)
summary: A MISALIGNMENT OF THE REAR SEAT CUSHION LATCHING BRACKET REINFORCEMENT PLATE TO THE FLOOR REQUIRED A MACHINE TAP TO CLEAR THE OPENING FOR A MOUNTING BOLT. THE TOP OF THE FUEL TANK MAY HAVE BEEN PUNCTURED WHEN THE TAP WAS USED.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM (1,415 affected)
summary: THE ANTI-LOCK BRAKE/TRACTION CONTROL COMPUTER LOGIC PROGRAM WAS INCOMPLETE, RESULTING IN THE TRAPPING OF BRAKE FLUID PRESSURE IN THE REAR BRAKE LINES. FAILURE TO RELEASE THE REAR BRAKE LINE PRESSURE CAUSES A CONDITION WHERE BRAKE PEDAL APPLICATION RESULTS IN ACTIVATION OF THE FRONT BRAKE ONLY, AND CONTINUAL REAR BRAKE DRAG.

title: Mazda North American Operations: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:UNKNOWN T (2,450 affected)
summary: THE LOWER ARM BALL JOINTS ON BOTH SIDES OF THE FRONT SUSPENSION MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TORQUED TO SPECIFICATION.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (131 affected)
summary: INSTALLATION OF SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE BOLTS FAILED TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS 210.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (22,452 affected)
summary: THE ACCELERATOR CABLE MAY HAVE BEEN KINKED DURING VEHICLE ASSEMBLY. THE KINK IN THE CABLE CAN CAUSE EITHER A HIGH EFFORT ACCELERATOR CABLE, STICKING ACCELERATOR CABLE, OR A BROKEN ACCELERATOR CABLE.

title: RENAULT, INCORPORATED: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HEATER CORE:WATER (540,000 affected)
summary: THE END CAP CONNECTING THE HEAT EXCHANGER'S CORE TO THE ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM COULD RUPTURE AND ALLOW HOT COOLANT TO ESCAPE INTO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS (115,000 affected)
summary: THE AUTOMATIC SHOULDER RESTRAINT SYSTEMS CAN MALFUNCTION AND BECOME INOPERATIVE.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HEATER CORE:WATER (650,000 affected)
summary: THE END CAP CONNECTING THE HEAT EXCHANGER'S CORE TO THE ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM COULD RUPTURE AND ALLOW HOT COOLANT TO ESCAPE INTO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN (20,413 affected)
summary: THE STEERING COLUMN SHAFT NUT RETAINING CLIP MAY BE MISSING. UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, THE LACK OF A RETAINING CLIP WILL ALLOW THE NUT TO WORK LOOSE AND THE STEERING WHEEL TO SEPARATE FROM THE STEERING COLUMN.

title: FWD CORPORATION: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT AIR SUSPENSION SYSTEM (38 affected)
summary: CRACKS HAVE DEVELOPED IN THE LOWER BEAM ASSEMBLIES AND THE SWAY BAR MOUNTING BRACKET ON THE RIDEWELL SUSPENSIONS USED TO INSTALL THE TILLER AXLE.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEATS (22,416 affected)
summary: THE VEHICLE FAILED TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS 208. THE DRIVER'S CHEST RESULTANT ACCELERATION EXCEEDED THE ALLOWABLE 60 G'S IN A CRASH TEST WHEN THE SEAT HEIGHT CHANGES ADJUSTMENT UNDER SEVERE FRONTAL IMPACT.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDALS AND LINKAGES (177 affected)
summary: THE PIVOT BOLT HOLDING THE BRAKE PEDAL TO ITS SUPPORT BRACKET MAY BE IMPROPERLY TIGHTENED AND MAY NOT HAVE ENGAGED THE LOCKING MATERIAL ON THE BOLT. THE BOLT CAN DISENGAGE FROM THE NUT.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (1,400 affected)
summary: A NUMBER OF CABS WERE ASSEMBLED WITH FEWER WELDS THAN SPECIFIED IN THE UPPER B PILLAR NEAR THE ANCHORAGE FOR THE SEAT BELT. WELDING MATERIALS USED ON THE INBOARD ANCHORAGE BRACKET UNDER THE CAB DECK WILL NOT MEET FMVSS NO. 210 LOAD TEST REQUIREMENTS WHEN THREE SEATING POSITIONS ARE PROVIDED.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL LINES FITTINGS:METALLIC (358,000 affected)
summary: THE FUEL HOSE ATTACHED TO THE FUEL DISTRIBUTION RAIL ON THE ENGINE MAY SHRINK BEYOND THE CLAMP FORCE OF THE FUEL HOSE CLAMPS, ALLOWING FUEL TO LEAK.

title: Pierce Manufacturing: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:PUMP (1,225 affected)
summary: THE KEY WHICH SECURES THE POWER STEERING PUMP MATING GEAR TO THE PUMP DRIVE SHAFT BREAKS AND FALLS OUT, ALLOWING THE MATING GEAR TO SPIN ON THE SHAFT OF THE POWER STEERING PUMP, RESULTING IN A LOSS OF POWER STEERING.

title: CARPENTER INDUSTRIES, INC.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM (16 affected)
summary: THE SCHOOL BUSES EXCEED THE CHASSIS MANUFACTURER'S GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT RATING (GVWR) BY 650 LBS. AND FAIL TO COMPLY WITH  FMVSS 105, "HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:CALIPER (1,254 affected)
summary: THERE IS INADEQUATE CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE FRONT DISC PADS AND THE CALIPER ASSEMBLY. HEAT BUILD UP CAN CAUSE THE BRAKE PAD BACKING PLATE TO EXPAND AND BIND IN THE CALIPER. THE BRAKE PADS WILL CONTINUOUSLY CONTACT THE BRAKE ROTOR, OVERHEATING THE FRONT ROTOR.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL (854 affected)
summary: THE REAR ENGINE COMPARTMENT COVER NEAR THE CRUISE CONTROL SERVO MOTOR SLIPS, CAUSING THE SAFETY CLIP IN THE SERVO MOTOR ARM TO BIND DUE TO INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE.  IF THE CRUISE CONTROL CABLE BINDS, THE ENGINE DOES NOT RETURN TO IDLE WHEN THE CRUISE CONTROL FUNCTION IS DISENGAGED, RESULTING IN THE VEHICLE SPEED NOT BEING REDUCED AS EXPECTED.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (306,000 affected)
summary: THE PLASTIC SLEEVE IN THE FRONT SAFETY BELT TONGUE ASSEMBLY WHICH RETAINS THE LOCK BAR CAN DETERIORATE FROM PROLONGED EXPOSURE TO SUNLIGHT AND BECOME DISPLACED, CAUSING THE TONGUE TO DETACH FROM THE SAFETY BELT WEBBING.
